fix_commit_message:
[maglev] Disable maglev_gdbjit without gdbjit

Without ENABLE_GDB_JIT_INTERFACE or --gdbjit the maglev metadata
collection should be disabled.

Fixes performance regressions from uselessly recording the data.
Also fixes a SIGSEGV crash during non-eager inlining where the
direct recursion check relied on the debug-only graph labeller's
provenance mapping (which is null in release/non-tracing builds).

CONV=c93eaeff-153c-452c-b913-29911d50be01

agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix 63226679f9f5 on top of intro 551ade488094 via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (NullPointerDereference): While refactoring MaglevGraphBuilder::CanInlineCall into a shared MaglevReducer<BaseT>::CanInlineCall template (used by both the maglev builder and turbolev), the recursion-detection check was changed to consult MaglevReducer::current_provenance().unit — data that is sourced from the MaglevGraphLabeller, a component that is only actively maintained when GDB JIT interface support / tracing (--gdbjit, ENABLE_GDB_JIT_INTERFACE) is enabled. In release/non-tracing builds this provenance's `unit` pointer can be null. Calling `->shared_function_info()` on it during non-eager function inlining dereferences a null pointer and crashes the process (SIGSEGV). Additionally, because the graph labeller bookkeeping was being unconditionally performed for this data (regardless of whether gdbjit/tracing was enabled), it caused a related performance regression, which the fix commit also addresses by gating maglev_gdbjit metadata collection behind the actual gdbjit/tracing flags. Root cause: The direct-recursion self-inlining check was changed from reading the builder's own always-valid MaglevCompilationUnit pointer to instead reading MaglevGraphLabeller-derived provenance data, which is only guaranteed to be populated when GDB JIT interface support or graph tracing is active. This coupled a functional correctness check to an optional, debug-only subsystem, producing a null-pointer dereference when that subsystem was disabled (the common release-build case).
